edition.label: Ab urbe condita
edition.description: Default reading edition. Books 1-142 (complete). Titi Livi ab urbe condita libri editionem priman, Pars I-IV, Libri I-XL. Editio Stereotypica. Weissenborn, Wilhelm; Mueller, Moritz, editors. Leipzig: Teubner, 1884-1911.

translation.label: History of Rome
translation.description: Default reading translation. Books 1-10, 21-45, with periochae 11-20. Livy. Ab Urbe Condita, With An English Translation. Foster, Benjamin Oliver; Moore, Frank Gardener; Sage, Evan T.; Schlesinger, Alfred C., translators. Cambridge, Mass.; London: Harvard University Press; William Heinemann, Ltd., 1919-1959. (Loeb Classical Library)

translation.label: History of Rome
translation.description: Supplementary translation. Books 1-10, 21-45. Livy. History of Rome, Volumes 1-2. Roberts, Canon, Rev, translator. London, New York: J. M. Dent and Sons; E. P. Dutton and Co., 1912.

translation.label: History of Rome
translation.description: Supplementary translation. Books 1-10, 21-45. Livy. History of Rome by Titus Livius. Spillan, D.; Edmonds, Cyrus; McDevitte, William A., translators. London: Henry G. Bohn, 1849-1868. (Bohn's Classical Library)

edition.label: Ab urbe condita
edition.description: Supplementary edition. Partial coverage: books 1-10, 21-30 only. Livy. Ab urbe condita. Conway, Robert Seymour; Walters, Charles Flamstead; Johnson, Stephen Keymer, editors. Oxford: Oxford University Press, 1914-1935. (Oxford Classical Texts)

edition.label: Ab urbe condita
edition.description: Supplementary edition (Latin text accompanying the Loeb translation). Partial coverage: books 1-5, 8-10, 21-30, 43-45, with periochae 11-20; books 6-7 and 31-42 have no Latin source text available. Livy. Ab Urbe Condita, With An English Translation. Foster, Benjamin Oliver; Moore, Frank Gardener; Schlesinger, Alfred C., editors. Cambridge, Mass.; London: Harvard University Press; William Heinemann, Ltd., 1919-1959. (Loeb Classical Library)

edition.label: Ab urbe condita libri, erklärt von M. Weissenborn
edition.description: Supplementary edition (German commentary text). Partial coverage: books 31-45 only. Livy. Ab urbe condita libri. Weissenborn, W.; Müller, H. J., editors. Berlin: Weidmannsche Buchhandlung, 1873-1883.
